risks.risk: Exact part(s) and compatibility are unclear (engine type/model, year, and whether these are complete engines or partial assemblies).
risks.proof: A clear photo of any engine ID plate/sticker (VIN/engine code) and the full set of parts included (wide shot + close-ups of key labels).
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed/unknown used engine parts with unknown compatibility (worst-case: incomplete/for parts only).

risks.risk: Condition is unknown: could be seized, cracked, missing sensors/hoses, or have internal damage.
risks.proof: Video/clip of compression test results (or at least a start/test video if it’s a complete engine), plus close-ups of any cracks, scoring, and missing components.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested and potentially damaged (worst-case: parts-only / non-working).

risks.risk: Quantity and completeness are unclear (seller may be showing multiple engines/parts but buyer may receive only some).
risks.proof: A numbered inventory list from the seller and photos showing each included component with counts (e.g., heads, manifolds, alternator, starter, ECU if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as receiving the least complete set consistent with the photo (worst-case: partial assemblies).

risks.risk: Potential mismatch between what’s shown and what’s sold (bait-and-switch with different engine/part).
risks.proof: Match the engine code/ID from the photo to the exact item being sold, with a close-up of the same ID before packing.
risks.if_unproven: Price with a fraud/return risk buffer (worst-case: no guarantee of correct item).

proof_requests: Tell me exactly what you are selling from this photo (complete engine vs engine block vs cylinder head vs manifolds), and the exact make/model/year it fits.
Send a clear close-up photo of the engine ID/engine code plate (or any stamped code) and any visible labels.
Send photos showing all included components with counts (what is included and what is not).
If it’s a complete engine: send a start/test video or compression test results; if it’s parts: send close-ups of wear/cracks and any missing items.
response.reason: The photo shows mixed engine assemblies/parts, but the exact item identity, compatibility, and condition cannot be confirmed remotely. Without the engine code/clear part list, a worst-case price would be too speculative.
